mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.score >= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as excellent, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.score >= 80 AND sc.score < 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as good, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.score >= 70 AND sc.score < 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as medium, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.score >= 60 AND sc.score < 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as pass, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.score < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as fail FROM score sc WHERE sc.deleted = 0 AND sc.exam_id = (SELECT id FROM exam WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY exam_date DESC LIMIT 1)
